llm.summary: This skill is a coherent workout transcription and summary helper, with a minor transparency note around optional dataset downloading and caching.

dimensions.detail: Local file reads/writes, Whisper/ffmpeg/curl examples, and optional cloud transcription are proportionate for audio summarization when user-directed; users in restricted environments should note the helper's default GitHub fetch.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains documentation and two helper Python scripts only; no install hook, background startup, package installer, or hidden execution mechanism was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill limits cloud transcription to configured credentials and user acceptance, and it tells the agent to keep workflows local by default; the exercise dataset helper can auto-download a public JSON dataset if no local copy exists, which is purpose-aligned but not prominently disclosed in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Generated transcripts and summaries are saved only when requested or for a recurring local workflow, while match_exercises.py may persist the public exercises dataset under the user's home cache without an explicit confirmation prompt.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to convert strength-training recordings or transcripts into compact WorkoutSummary notes, and the referenced workflow, helper scripts, transcription options, duration calculation, and exercise-name matching all support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want local workout transcript summarization and are comfortable with user-directed file processing. Prefer local Whisper for private recordings, only use cloud transcription after explicitly accepting upload to that provider, and pre-supply a local exercise dataset or cache path if your environment should avoid automatic GitHub downloads.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Reading recordings/transcripts, writing requested summaries, invoking local audio tools, and optional cloud transcription fit the skill's purpose; the artifacts also instruct that cloud transcription requires configured credentials and user acceptance.
[TP4] expected: Dataset matching is not unrelated to summarization because the skill explicitly standardizes exercise names; the auto-fetch/cache details are less visible than ideal but do not show hidden user-data exfiltration or purpose mismatch.
[SDI-1] expected: The helper downloads and caches a public exercise dataset only when no local dataset/cache is present, supporting canonical exercise matching; the lack of an opt-in or pinned checksum is a transparency and supply-chain note rather than malicious behavior.
[SDI-2] expected: The hardcoded GitHub raw URL points to a public exercise dataset used as reference data, not executable code; users who require offline or pinned dependencies should provide --dataset or --cache explicitly.
[SQP-2] expected: The local cache write is expected for reuse of the exercise dataset, but runtime notice would improve operator visibility.
